external_ask: 请检索并确认是否存在以下类型的研究：1. 针对接受免疫检查点抑制剂治疗的实体瘤患者，测定其血清或肿瘤组织中肌苷浓度的研究，并报告该浓度与临床响应（ORR/PFS）的相关性；2. 针对同一人群，测定血清或肿瘤组织中短链脂肪酸（乙酸、丙酸、丁酸等）浓度的研究，并报告其与临床响应的相关性及具体浓度数值。
limits: 需要寻找并提取具体的临床研究数据，这些数据必须包含：1. 在人类实体瘤患者的肿瘤组织（TME）或配对血清样本中测得的肌苷和/或短链脂肪酸的绝对浓度值（单位需明确为 μM 或 ng/mL）；2. 这些浓度值与 ICI 治疗结局（如客观缓解率 ORR、无进展生存期 PFS 等）之间的统计学关联分析。
question: 人体肿瘤微环境或配对血清中肌苷及短链脂肪酸的具体生理浓度是多少，且是否与 ICI 响应直接相关？
read_focus: 重点检索涉及接受 ICI 治疗的实体瘤患者的代谢组学研究，特别是那些同时报道了肌苷和 SCFAs 在血液或肿瘤组织中的定量数据的论文。注意区分粪便微生物群数据与体内（血清/TME）代谢物数据的差异，后者才是回答当前问题的关键。
still_missing: 提供的文本未报告人类血浆或肿瘤微环境中肌苷的绝对浓度数值（如 μM 或 ng/mL），仅使用了基于中位数的‘高/低’分组进行生存分析。成功标准要求的 ORR 或 PFS 与肌苷浓度的直接统计关联在文本中主要体现为 OS（总生存期），ORR/PFS 数据主要关联于 UBA6 表达而非肌苷浓度。此外，文本未提供短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）在人体内的具体浓度数据。人类肿瘤微环境（TME）中的肌苷浓度数据缺失，仅有血浆数据。
usable_content: ['该研究在人类肾细胞癌（RCC）患者（CheckMate 025 试验，n=394 nivolumab 组）的血浆代谢组分析中，发现肌苷（inosine）水平与免疫检查点阻断（ICB）治疗后的总生存期（OS）显著相关（高肌苷组中位 OS 33 个月 vs 低肌苷组 22 个月），且这种关联在依维莫司对照组中不存在。', '研究揭示了肌苷增强 ICB 疗效的分子机制：肌苷直接进入肿瘤细胞，抑制泛素激活酶 UBA6 的活性，从而解除其对炎症信号和抗原呈递通路的抑制，提高肿瘤细胞对 T 细胞介导杀伤的敏感性。', '研究指出肌苷在人体血浆中的测量存在技术挑战，因为腺苷可快速降解为肌苷（约 10 秒）且在体内清除快，而肌苷半衰期较长（约 15 小时），这可能影响血浆肌苷浓度的准确测定。', '在人类肿瘤组织队列（n=22，抗 PD1 治疗）中，肿瘤细胞 UBA6 蛋白表达水平与 ICB 响应（ORR：低 UBA6 组 50% vs 高 UBA6 组 17%）及 CD8+ T 细胞浸润呈负相关，作为肌苷下游效应的替代标志物。'] This study provides clinical evidence that oral inosine supplementation (0.2 g, three times/day) combined with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors significantly prolonged median progression-free survival (7.00 vs 4.40 months; HR 0.63, p = 0.011) compared to inhibitors alone in 172 patients with advanced solid tumors. Although the objective response rate (26.7% vs 15.1%) did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.061), the data establish a clinical association between exogenous inosine exposure and improved ICI outcomes (PFS). Subgroup analyses indicated stronger PFS benefits in lung cancer patients (HR 0.45) and those with specific inflammatory markers (e.g., LDH≥216, NLR<4), suggesting patient stratification factors relevant to metabolite efficacy. This review identifies inosine and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) as key microbial metabolites influencing immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) efficacy. It reports that elevated fecal levels of acetate, propionate, butyrate, and valerate are associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS) and better treatment response in a prospective study of 52 solid tumor patients receiving anti-PD-1 therapy. It also cites evidence that high systemic butyrate and propionate levels correlate with CTLA-4 blockade resistance. Regarding inosine, the review describes a mechanism where B. pseudolongum-produced inosine translocates systemically to activate antitumor T cells and improve ICI efficacy. The text provides specific citation markers (e.g., [112], [156], [161]) pointing to primary studies that likely contain the raw concentration data and statistical associations required. This study investigated the role of Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) signaling via EP2 and EP4 receptors in regulating the tumor microenvironment (TME) and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response. The authors found that dual antagonism of EP2/EP4 (using DX-002) reversed PGE2-mediated immune suppression in NK cells and synergized with anti-PD1 therapy to increase CD8+ T cell infiltration and tumor regression in mouse models. The text notes that prior work has shown high levels of PGE2-EP2/EP4 associated inflammatory signatures correlate with poor prognosis and worse ICI response in multiple human cancer types, establishing a precedent for metabolite-mediated regulation of ICI efficacy. ['该研究在人类肾细胞癌（RCC）患者队列（CheckMate 025，n=394 nivolumab 治疗）中分析了血浆代谢谱，发现肌苷（inosine）水平与免疫检查点阻断（ICB）治疗后的总生存期（OS）显著相关（高肌苷组中位 OS 33 个月 vs 低肌苷组 22 个月，P < 0.01）。', '研究通过未靶向代谢组学确认了肌苷水平与 ICB 敏感性在 mouse 和 human 中均存在关联，且这种关联特异性存在于 ICB 治疗组（nivolumab），而不存在于 mTOR 抑制剂组（everolimus）。', '研究揭示了肌苷增强 ICB 疗效的分子机制：肌苷直接进入肿瘤细胞，抑制泛素激活酶 UBA6，从而上调 MHC-I 表达和炎症信号通路，增强肿瘤免疫原性。', '在包含 22 名实体瘤患者（食管、胃、肺、结肠癌等）的小型 basket trial 队列中，肿瘤组织 UBA6 蛋白表达水平（作为肌苷作用的下游指标）与抗 PD-1 治疗的客观缓解率（ORR）相关（低 UBA6 组 ORR 50% vs 高 UBA6 组 17%），且与 CD8+ T 细胞浸润负相关。'] This study prospectively analyzed 47 patients with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (R/R-DLBCL) receiving CD19 CAR T-cell therapy. It quantified serum inosine and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs: acetate, butyrate, isovalerate) using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. The authors reported that responders had significantly higher pretreatment serum inosine levels compared to non-responders (P = .042), and submedian serum inosine was an independent predictor of shorter progression-free survival (Multivariate HR 2.78, P = .024). For SCFAs, higher serum acetate and butyrate were associated with the absence of adverse events (CRS/ICANS), while elevated isovalerate was linked to the presence of adverse events. The study also identified an enrichment of inosine biosynthesis pathways in the gut microbiome of responders and demonstrated in vitro that inosine could enhance CAR T-cell cytotoxicity via the adenosine A2A receptor.
